You have experience managing and developing agile teams in an Agile and DevSecOps environment. You effectively build relationships with business stakeholders and make decisions in a multi-stakeholder environment. You understand the specifics of working in a regulated financial market. Additional Assets Experience with headless CMS solutions. Knowledge of web analytics tools. Experience with CI/CD tooling and API-first approaches. Experience in recruiting Java and React developers. Unsure if you meet 100% of the criteria? We encourage you to apply anyway. We are excited to learn about your unique qualities. Become a supporter of change at NN Are you excited about this vacancy? Do you think you would be a good fit for NN and the team? Then we invite you to apply. We are eager to learn more about who you are, what motivates you and what you can contribute.

review_candidates.title: Customer Operations Manager Silvus
review_candidates.description: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Silvus Technologies, a Motorola Solutions company, is dedicated to one mission: connecting those who keep us safe. We do so by delivering the most advanced Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) radios powered by our custom and ever-evolving Mobile-Networked MIMO waveform. Together, our radios and waveform provide vital communications for mission-critical applications in the harshest environments from underground tunnels to high-altitude balloons. Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”? Silvus’ rapid growth is fueled by a focus on research and innovation and a team of the most passionate, skilled, and creative thinking individuals. If you are looking for a challenging experience, you owe it to yourself to learn how Silvus can be the next chapter of your career. Job Description Mission: Silvus is seeking a C ustomer Operations Manager who will report to the International Customer Operations Lead. The successful individual in this role will serve as the primary post-sales operational liaison between our key customers and Silvus manufacturing organization and internal associated departments. The mission is to manage purchase orders, production schedules, delivery coordination to ensure components are delivered on time and integrated successfully into the customer’s long-term production roadmap. This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location. The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion. Key Responsibilities Customer Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for customer post sale, managing day-to-day operational needs and escalations. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to report on delivery performance, quality metrics, and roadmap alignment. Demand Planning & Forecast Integration: Work directly with customer demand planners to ingest production forecasts. Translate these into actionable data for our internal manufacturing and supply chain teams to prevent stockouts or overages. Delivery Management: Track and manage open purchase orders to ensure on-time delivery commitments are met, partnering with manufacturing and logistics to resolve delays. Technical Advocacy & Issue Resolution: Identify technical hurdles or integration challenges the customer is facing. Partner with Engineering to resolve issues and manage the formal escalation process for any hardware defects or shipping delays. Lifecycle Management: Monitor component performance in the field. Manage the communication of End-of-Life (EOL) notices and transition customers to next- generation components. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" internally, providing feedback to Product Development to influence the design of future components or products. RMA Management: Managing the Return Merchandise Authorization process - making sure that if a part fails, the customer gets a replacement immediately and your engineering team gets the "dead" part back for analysis. Regional Expertise: Navigate the specific logistical, legal, and contractual complexities unique to key countries like Germany and the Ukrainian theater. Perform other related duties of which the above are representative. Basic Requirements Candidate Profile A self-motivated professional who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and takes full ownership of multitasking and shifting priorities. Languages: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills in English and German. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field. Experience: 5+ years in a post-sales, account management, or technical project management role, preferably within the Defense, Aerospace, Robotics, or Semiconductor industries. Analytical Prowess: Ability to analyze complex spreadsheets and production schedules to find discrepancies between demand and supply. Communication: Demonstrated ability to "translate" between a customer's high-level business needs and a factory's granular production constraints. Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the drone ecosystem (UAV regulations, flight controllers, propulsion systems) is a significant plus. Experience managing military or defense-sector clients is considered a significant asset. All employment is contingent upon the successful clearance of a background check. Working Conditions & Physical Requirements Office environment. Trade shows. Outdoor environment for occasional field demonstrations. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to do the following: ○ Lift equipment up to 20lbs. for the set-up of demonstrations and testing. ○ Manage the movement of large suitcase size Pelican cases (i.e. travel, demos, etc.) ○ Extended periods of sitting. #silvuscareers Travel Requirements 10-25% Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan Yes Company Motorola Solutions Germany GmbH EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

review_candidates.title: Country Representative - Strategic Campaigns & Policy
review_candidates.description: Location: Remote (based in Estonia) Contract: 12 months, full-time, service agreement. Nidus Balticus is looking for an entrepreneurial and proactive Country Representative to lead and grow our work in Estonia. This is a highly autonomous role with significant ownership of Nidus Balticus’ strategic delivery in Estonia. You will implement Nidus Balticus’ country strategy, developing programmes, partnerships and policy initiatives that advance our strategic objectives. One priority will be leading the next phase of our work in Ida-Virumaa – strengthening its political and policy impact, developing partnerships around regional priorities, and connecting local priorities with national political and investment decisions. Beyond Ida-Virumaa, you will be expected to identify and develop new programme and partnership opportunities, expand our ecosystem of collaborators, and contribute to shaping Nidus Balticus’ broader policy and campaign agenda in Estonia. As our presence grows, you will build a local team. You will report directly to the Executive Director and collaborate closely with the Chief Operations Officer, PR Manager, and other Country Leads. About Nidus Balticus Nidus Balticus is a non-profit organization working to strengthen energy independence, environmental stewardship, and national security across the Baltics. We bring underrepresented voices into energy and environmental policy conversations, building broad coalitions that connect local communities, civil society, businesses, and policymakers. By turning community engagement into public support, we help create the political momentum needed to deliver lasting policy change. Nidus Balticus is part of Our Common Home (OCH) – a global network that brings those excluded from the climate movement into the conversation about protecting their environment, on their own terms. Our 10+ network organizations are active across four continents, supported by a global team providing world-class expertise in campaigns, impact measurement, research, and operations. Key Responsibilities Country strategy & strategic delivery: Lead the implementation of Nidus Balticus’ Estonia strategy, translating strategic priorities into programmes, campaigns, partnerships and policy initiatives. Identify opportunities to expand our impact and strengthen our presence in Estonia, and take ownership of new initiatives. Programme development & delivery: Design, launch and deliver strategic campaigns and programmes, including the continued development of our flagship work in Ida-Virumaa. Oversee implementation, coordinate local partners and vendors, manage budgets and timelines, and ensure programmes achieve societal and policy impact. Partnerships & ecosystem development: Build and nurture an ecosystem of partners across civil society, business, academia, municipalities, and government. Establish strategic partnerships and alliances that strengthen impact, policy influence, and programme delivery. New opportunities & partnerships: Continuously identify and develop new programme, campaign and partnership opportunities aligned with the mission and country strategy. Identify emerging political and societal needs, assess opportunities for Nidus Balticus to create impact, and turn relevant opportunities into concrete initiatives. Policy engagement: Build relationships with policymakers and public institutions, contribute to policy discussions, and support our advocacy work in Estonia. Leadership & team development: Help establish and grow Nidus Balticus' presence in Estonia by identifying future talent, supporting recruitment, and gradually building and leading a high-performing local team. Public representation: Represent Nidus Balticus at conferences, public events, stakeholder meetings, and in regional media. Impact & reporting: Monitor programme impact, gather community insights, and contribute to reports, case studies, and learning processes. Requirements Experience: 5–8+ years of relevant professional experience in public affairs, advocacy, strategic partnerships, regional development, programme development, community engagement, or ecosystem building, ideally with ownership of complex initiatives or organisational growth. Stakeholder engagement: Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across different sectors and work effectively with diverse communities. Ecosystem building: Proven ability to develop multi-stakeholder partnerships and build collaborative ecosystems involving civil society, businesses, public institutions, and local communities. Regional expertise: Good understanding of Estonia's political, social, and economic landscape. Familiarity with Ida-Virumaa and existing networks in the region would be a strong advantage. Languages: Fluency in Estonian and English is essential. Russian language skills are highly desirable for engaging diverse communities and stakeholders. Organization: Strong project management skills with the ability to independently coordinate multiple workstreams. Communication: Excellent interpersonal and public speaking skills, with the ability to build trust across diverse audiences. Entrepreneurial mindset: High degree of ownership, autonomy and initiative. Proactively identifies opportunities, is comfortable operating with ambiguity, and can take an initiative from an early opportunity through relationship-building, programme development and implementation. Who is the Ideal Candidate? Relevant backgrounds may include: Community development & NGOs: Experience leading outreach, mobilization, or partnership-building within civil society or community projects. Public affairs & advocacy: Experience engaging policymakers, public institutions, or industry stakeholders on policy or advocacy initiatives. Business & industry associations: Experience working within chambers of commerce, business associations, sector organizations, employers' associations, or regional development bodies, bringing stakeholders together around shared policy objectives. Ecosystem building & strategic partnerships: A proven track record of building cross-sector partnerships between NGOs, businesses, public institutions, research organisations, foundations, or community groups. Regional development: Experience working with municipalities, local development organizations, regional initiatives, or place-based economic development. Project management: Experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple partners, timelines, and deliverables. What We Offer Autonomy: High degree of freedom in planning and executing your work. Vivência na construção de Orçamento e Forecast com cenários múltiplos. Diferenciais Experiência com ERP Automação de relatórios e análises (Python, VBA, Power Query/M). Conhecimento de ferramentas de BI Uso de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas a produtividade e análises financeiras Vivência prévia no setor de educação Informações adicionais Benefícios: Plano de saúde Amil Black. Com foco na melhoria da educação pública com equidade, atua para garantir a aprendizagem, a permanência e a progressão dos estudantes ao longo de sua trajetória escolar, para que desenvolvam as competências necessárias e prosperem na vida. A principal estratégia é o desenvolvimento de lideranças públicas diversas e o apoio técnico à gestão, com base em evidências, diagnóstico, planejamento e implementação de políticas educacionais. Atua com profundidade temática, garantida por metodologias consolidadas e pela experiência prática nos temas de alfabetização, Escola para as Adolescências — com foco na educação integral e em o tempo integral —, recomposição de aprendizagens e desenvolvimento de lideranças no setor público. Adota a ação implementadora e atua desde o diagnóstico até a avaliação das políticas públicas, com estratégias que integram planejamento, formação, gestão e práticas pedagógicas. Por fim, apoia os governos na entrega de resultados sustentáveis com equidade racial e de gênero, promovendo impactos de curto, médio e longo prazo e fortalece capacidades institucionais para resultados duradouros. Juntas e juntos, buscamos alcançar grandes resultados e construir um legado de impacto duradouro em nosso país. Topa esse desafio com a gente? Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão Acreditamos no impacto positivo de pessoas diversas e através dessa perspectiva desejamos ter a nossa sociedade representada em nossos times, por isso estimulamos e promovemos espaços que garantam equidade e inclusão através de políticas internas, capacitações, eventos, programas e metas. Esse é o nosso compromisso para seguirmos aumentando nosso impacto com um time composto por diferentes percursos, origens, vivências e saberes.
